context: A teacher helps a teen prep an essay about peace history
purpose: Teach: 終戦/祝福/ノルウェー/義務教育/にまつわる/極東/篇/携わっ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 作文のテーマ、もう決まった？平和の歴史って広いから、視点を絞らないと大変よ。
lines.en: Have you decided on your essay topic? Peace history is broad, so you need to narrow your angle.
lines.style: Gentle teacher voice, calm guiding tone, slightly maternal warmth and patience

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うーん、終戦直後の日本にしようかなって思ってるんですけど、資料が多すぎて。
lines.en: Hmm, I was thinking about Japan right after the war ended, but there are too many sources.
lines.style: Teen girl, slightly hesitant, thinking out loud with rising intonation

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いいテーマね。じゃあ、極東国際軍事裁判にまつわる話なんてどう？意外と義務教育では深く扱わないし。
lines.en: Good topic. How about something connected to the Far East war tribunal? Surprisingly, compulsory education doesn't cover it deeply.
lines.style: Teacher mode, animated and intellectually engaged, offering a specific suggestion

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あー、聞いたことあります！でも難しそう…先生はそういう研究に携わったことあるんですか？
lines.en: Oh, I've heard of that! But it sounds hard… Have you ever been involved in that kind of research?
lines.style: Curious teen, slight admiration creeping in, leaning forward in voice

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大学院の頃にね、戦後外交史の一篇を書いたの。ノルウェーのノーベル平和賞史料も少し読んだわ。
lines.en: Back in grad school I wrote one chapter on postwar diplomacy. I also read a bit of Norway's Nobel Peace Prize archives.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly nostalgic, sharing a personal academic anecdote softly

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ノルウェー！？すごい…なんか先生って秘密の経歴ありますよね。
lines.en: Norway?! Wow… you really do have a secret backstory, sensei.
lines.style: Excited teen, half-teasing half-impressed, bright tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ふふ、大げさよ。でもね、戦争を生き延びた人たちが、平和を祝福として受け止めた言葉が忘れられなくて。
lines.en: Haha, you're exaggerating. But the words of survivors who received peace as a blessing—I just can't forget them.
lines.style: Soft laugh, then sincere and quietly emotional, slowing down at the end

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なんかちょっと泣きそう…そういう実感のこもった話、作文に入れたいです。
lines.en: That almost made me tear up… I want to include that kind of heartfelt perspective in my essay.
lines.style: Touched teen, voice softening, newly motivated and a bit shy
